texte.Was du in die Warteliste, eine Anfrage f: What you enter on the waiting list, in an enquiry for your own party or in a message to us (name, email or phone, day, seats and your lines) goes encrypted to the Culinarium team. It sits on a server in Frankfurt am Main only until the team collects it, and after that with the team alone. It is deleted after twelve months, or at once on request: write to us or call the bar.

What you enter on the waiting list, in an enquiry for your own party, for a voucher or in a message to us (name, email or phone, day, seats and your lines) goes encrypted to the Culinarium team. It sits on a server in Frankfurt am Main only until the team collects it, and after that with the team alone. It is deleted after twelve months, or at once on request: write to us or call the bar.
texte.Was du den Chat fragst, wird mit seiner: What you ask the chat on the German pages is stored with its answer and goes the same way to the team, so it can answer unanswered questions itself. Your name and address are not part of it, no cookie is set; a checksum that changes every day only limits how often one device can ask.
